content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to install the Portuguese language, but the Update Center option is not selectable. Does anyone have a solution? Thanks in advance, [user_name]

You can download the language file here: [url] Save the file in the directory of the [product_name] program. To find the directory, right-click on its icon on the desktop and select the option to open the directory, or similar. Use 7zip or another extraction tool to extract the *.luf file; it will typically place the contents in a help folder within the [product_name] directory. After extraction, launch the [product_name] program and change the language via the options menu. Regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], Did you install it under [product_name] V8.2?
Yes, I installed it on [product_name] V8.2.0 and activated the language for testing. After reading this thread, I noticed the same issue: the Update Center cannot be selected. Regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], Your installation instructions may work, but it's likely to install the incorrect version of the Portuguese language file. The file linked is specific to [product_name] V8.0. Installing it in V8.2 may result in missing menu items and error messages, because there isn’t a V8.2-compatible language file. Check the display for the "Float / Integer converter" blocks—they only exist from a particular release onward.

You're correct; new entries in V8.2.0 appear in English. Another language file might exist for V8.2.0, but I haven't searched for it yet. Otherwise, using the 'wrong' language file still gives a mostly translated menu (about 99%). The main takeaway is that *.luf files can be extracted with 7zip in the [product_name] directory when the Update Center doesn’t work. Regards, [user_name]
I was aware that language files could be installed this way. However, since there are no official files for [product_name] V8.1 and V8.2 on the [company_name] website, I didn’t suggest this method.

Now others are aware that the language can be installed in this manner. I don’t see an issue with using the V8.0 language file; anyone can compare the English version with their own language to review all entries. This morning, I found a note in the help section of V8.2.0 indicating that the Update Center is disabled for this version. Regards, [user_name]

Yes, in [product_name] V8.2 the Update Center is disabled due to technical constraints. It hasn't been decided how language files will be managed in future versions. Hint: The usual updates are still available on the [product_name] pages. Link: [url] [company_name] Support

analysis.insight_summary: Users trying to install the Portuguese language for [product_name] V8.2 were challenged by the unavailable Update Center, which blocked the standard installation process. Manual extraction of language files provided a workaround, but only files for older versions (V8.0) could be found, causing incomplete translations and missing features. The Update Center deactivation was later confirmed by support as a technical matter, with no official language files offered for V8.2.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a straightforward method to add and activate Portuguese in [product_name] V8.2, preferably through the Update Center or a comparable official solution, to ensure a fully translated interface.
